column2: MolmoWeb: An open agent for automating web tasks

column2: Asta: Accelerating science through trustworthy agentic AI
column6: Fetched: partly an ecosystem announcement, but contains AstaBench empirical findings across 57 agents/22 architectures with scores (Asta v0 53.0%, ReAct-gpt-4o ~43%, ReAct-claude-3-5-haiku 20%) -- qualifying empirical findings on named systems.

column2: RewardBench: The first benchmark & leaderboard for reward models used in RLHF
column6: Fetched: Ai2 benchmark/leaderboard evaluating 30+ named reward models (Starling-RM-34B, tulu-2-dpo-70b, Mixtral-8x7B) with the empirical finding that DPO RMs fail to generalize to popular preference test sets -- qualifying empirical findings.

column2: Perspectra: Choosing Your Experts Enhances Critical Thinking in Multi-Agent Research Ideation
column6: Metadata via S2 API (page returns no content to non-browser clients). CHI multi-agent ideation TOOL with a human-subjects study on users critical thinking; findings are about human users, not an AI model capability/behavior/safeguard -- no qualifying model finding. In-window.

column2: Understanding the Logic of Direct Preference Alignment through Logic
column6: Metadata via S2 API. ICML paper formalizing DPO/DPA losses as symbolic reasoning problems -- a theoretical/conceptual framework, no empirical evaluation or measured findings about named models. In-window.

column2: Re-evaluating Automatic LLM System Ranking for Alignment with Human Preference
column6: Metadata via S2 API. NAACL meta-evaluation (Ai2 co-authors Bragg, Cohan) experimentally studying how automatic LLM-bencher components affect ranking alignment with human preference -- qualifying methodology/tooling findings. In-window.

column2: Paloma: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Model Fit
column6: Metadata via S2 API. Ai2 benchmark measuring LM perplexity fit across 546 domains, releasing and empirically comparing 6 controlled 1B baseline LMs -- qualifying empirical/methodology findings on named models.

column2: CLIN: A Continually Learning Language Agent for Rapid Task Adaptation and Generalization
column6: Metadata via S2 API (Ai2 authors Dalvi, Tafjord, Tandon, Clark). Reports empirical finding that CLIN continually improves across trials on ScienceWorld without parameter updates -- qualifying empirical model-capability finding.

column2: m&m's: A Benchmark to Evaluate Tool-Use for multi-step multi-modal Tasks
column6: Fetched arXiv abstract: benchmark of 4K+ multi-step multi-modal tasks (33 tools) empirically evaluating 10 popular LLMs on planning strategy, plan format and feedback -- qualifying empirical findings on named models.

column2: To Tell The Truth: Language of Deception and Language Models
